class.name: SteamPurchaseItem
class.brief_description: Backend-priced offer for a single game SKU.

method.name: create
method.description: Creates an offer from the authenticated backend's pricing. Amount must be positive in Steam's units for the three-letter uppercase currency code. Invalid offers return null.

members.member: Localized item display name supplied by the game backend.
Price in Steam's units for the currency.
Three-letter uppercase currency code for this price.
